evals.prompt: Review this Go repository's architecture rules and add a go-arch-lint gate without forcing a four-layer layout. Verify package selections are nonempty and inspect the installed tool help first.
evals.expected_output: Repository-owned rules, observed help/version, nonempty selection checks, and separate actual/proposed findings.

evals.prompt: A Go handler imports storage directly. Add an allowed and forbidden architecture example, keep the forbidden check real, and explain what architecture lint cannot prove about authorization and writes.
evals.expected_output: Real dependency examples, no policy weakening, and explicit behavior-test boundary.

evals.prompt: The proposed Go architecture rule matches zero packages. Diagnose it as setup failure rather than a passing scan and report the limitation honestly.
evals.expected_output: Clear missing-selection diagnosis and no invented tool behavior.

evals.prompt: An agent repair changes the architecture checker. Verify the repair preserves the policy and gate hashes while keeping all real checker tests active and rerunning the lint gate.
evals.expected_output: Repair accepted only when rule and gate hashes remain unchanged and the real checks pass.
